symptom: `describe java action` on an action with a documented parameter printed `Name: String not null -- This sets the Name of the tool...,` so the comma sat inside the comment and `mxcli check` of the output failed `line 255:4 mismatched input 'Name' expecting ')'`.
cause: The parameter loop wrote the `, ` separator at the start of the next iteration, i.e. after the previous parameter's trailing `-- doc` comment. The JavaScript action describer is a copy of the same loop and had the same bug.
fix: Write the separator at the end of each non-final parameter, before its `--` comment (cmd_javaactions.go and cmd_javascript_actions.go).
insight: Any describer that emits a trailing `--` comment must emit list separators before it; a separator written 'before the next item' is only safe when nothing line-terminating can come between. grep `"  -- "` in mdl/executor for other list emitters. A describe->visitor.Build round trip catches it; a substring assertion on the describe text does not. Avoid naming a test parameter `Count`: it is an MDL keyword and the parser's keyword hint then masks the real error.
test: mdl/executor/describe_code_action_param_separator_test.go TestDescribeJavaAction_ParamDocCommentKeepsSeparator, TestDescribeJavaScriptAction_ParamDocCommentKeepsSeparator; control: both fail `mismatched input 'Amount' expecting ')'` with the fix reverted
